Group rides in Kansas

9 recurring group rides around Kansas: 4 gravel, 3 road, 3 social. 7 roll on weeknights, 1 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with BRBC Monday Social Ride in Leawood — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Velas Thursday Women's Ride runs usually two distance options, all skill levels.
